'''''Cynoglossum amabile''''', the '''Chinese hound's tongue'''<ref>[https://plants.usda.gov/java/profile?symbol=CYAM3 ''Cynoglossum amabile''] at [https://plants.usda.gov/ USDA PLANTS Database]</ref> or '''Chinese forget-me-not''', is a [[species]]  of [[flowering plant]] in the [[family (botany)|family]] Boraginaceae, native to Asia.<ref>{{GRIN | accessdate = 16 January 2018}}</ref> A [[hardiness (plants)|hardy]] [[annual plant|annual]] growing to {{convert|50 |cm|in|abbr=on}}, it has hairy leaves and cymes of sky-blue flowers in late summer. This plant, closely related to the common forget-me-not of temperate gardens (''[[Myosotis sylvatica]]''), is also grown as an [[ornamental plant|ornamental]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ces.ncsu.edu/depts/hort/consumer/factsheets/annuals/chineseforgetmenot.html |title=''Cynoglossum amabile'' at NC State University |access-date=2007-04-11 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070203182654/http://www.ces.ncsu.edu/depts/hort/consumer/factsheets/annuals/chineseforgetmenot.html |archive-date=2007-02-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref> In cultivation in the [[United Kingdom|UK]] it has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web | url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/5194/Cynoglossum-amabile/Details | title = Cynoglossum amabile - Chinese forget-me-not | publisher = [[Royal Horticultural Society]] | accessdate=15 August 2018}}</ref> (confirmed 2017).<ref>{{cite web  | url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants - Ornamental | date = July 2017 | page = 26 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | accessdate = 24 January 2018}}</ref>

The Latin [[binomial nomenclature|specific epithet]] ''amabile'' means "lovely".<ref name=RHSLG>{{cite book |last=Harrison |first=Lorraine |title=RHS Latin for Gardeners |year=2012 |publisher=Mitchell Beazley |location=United Kingdom |isbn=978-1845337315 }}</ref>

[[File:Chinese Forget-me-not 15-06-2025.jpg|thumb|A close up of the blossoms and buds of Cynoglossum amabile]]
